2. With the 4 blackstone, craft 6 blackstone walls using the recipe 'craft 6 blackstone wall using 6 blackstone.'
3. From these 6 blackstone walls, you can now get blackstone by picking one of the walls apart; they can be broken into multiple smaller pieces, including small amounts of blackstone.
4. Use the blackstone obtained from breaking the walls to create 6 polished blackstone, following the recipe 'craft 4 polished blackstone using 4 blackstone.'
5. Now with 6 polished blackstones, use the recipe 'craft 1 polished blackstone pressure plate using 2 polished blackstone' twice to get 4 polished blackstone pressure plates.
6. Finally, use 1 of the remaining polished blackstones to craft 1 polished blackstone button using the recipe 'craft 1 polished blackstone button using 1 polished blackstone.'

- Find 4 blackstone blocks or create them.
- Break 2 of the blackstone blocks to obtain 2 more blackstone pieces for making walls.
- Craft 6 blackstone walls using the 8 blackstone pieces.
- Break one of the walls into small pieces to find additional blackstone.
- Use all 4 blackstone pieces to craft 6 polished blackstones.
- Take 4 of the polished blackstones and craft 4 polished blackstone pressure plates.
- Take the last polished blackstone and craft 1 polished blackstone button using it.

This strategy ensures that you minimize waste and efficiently use resources to achieve the goal of crafting the polished blackstone button.
